title: Rav Acha bar Oshaya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Rosh, beginning of chapter 1 of Eruvin, citing the Jerusalem Talmud there; the Jerusalem Talmud text Hyman uses reads “Rav Acha in the name of Rabbi Hoshaya.”[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Vilna Rosh on Eruvin 1:4 quotes Rabbi Acha bar Oshaya, whereas the Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:1 has Rabbi Acha in the name of Rabbi Hoshaya. Hyman’s fully written Rav heading and Rav Acha wording are retained beside these digital Rabbi forms. The patronymic and reporting chain remain distinct, without a genealogical correction or identity merger.
